7.1.10.7 SetMessageFiltering
[SWS_Dlt_00775] ⌈If the Dlt command Dlt_SetMessageFiltering is requested,
all the Dlt filters shall be enabled/disabled as requested, and the Dlt command shall be
answered with E_OK. Disabled filters will allow all messages to pass.⌋
caption: 7.1.10.7 SetMessageFiltering
